products.title: Grid Fleece Swoveralls - Glacier Navy
products.body_html:
Grid fleece is the stuff outdoor people have quietly worn under their shells for years. Flip it inside out and you'll see why: a field of tiny raised squares. Each one holds a little pocket of warm air against you, and the channels between them let heat and sweat escape. Warm when you're sitting still. Not swampy when you're not.

In Glacier Navy. Deep, cold blue. Like a glacier, except it keeps you warm, which glaciers are famously bad at.

Details & Fit

  • Super Soft Blend of recycled poly (94%), and spandex (6%)
  • Inside-bib, secret front pocket with zipper closure
  • Deep front bib and side pockets
  • Boot Pant Cuff Finish
  • Adjustable Straps
  • Zipper fly
  • Unisex Sizing

Why grid fleece rocks:

  • The squares trap heat. Raised grid blocks hold a thin layer of warm air right where you want it.
  • The channels let it breathe. Air moves through the gaps, so you stay warm without cooking.
  • Warmth without the bulk. Lighter than it looks, so you get fleece warmth without dressing like a sleeping bag. 
  • Moves moisture, dries fast. 
  • Stretches with you. 

Materials & Care

  • Super Soft Blend of recycled poly (94%), and spandex (6%)
  • Swoveralls are pre-washed to prevent shrinkage
  • Machine wash cold, tumble dry on low
  • We recommend turning them inside out to prevent pilling

products.title: The Free Your Waistband Beanie - Black
products.body_html:
The rallying cry, now available for your head. Our Free Your Waistband badge sits front and center on the cuff, a small circular reminder that you gave up elastic prisons a long time ago and never looked back.

This is The Game's fine gauge knit roll up beanie, which is headwear-speak for soft, stretchy, and not itchy. The fine gauge knit lies smooth instead of bulky, the cuff folds where you want it, and one size genuinely fits most heads. Pick Sunglow if your winter needs more sunshine. Pick Black if your winter wardrobe is a commitment.

Sweatpants + Overalls = Swoveralls. Beanie + Swoveralls = the full uniform.

The Details

  • Fine gauge knit construction
  • Cuffed roll up silhouette
  • One size fits most
  • Free Your Waistband circle badge, flat embroidery on cuff (7.0cm x 4.5cm)
  • White, gumdrop, and black threads
  • Available in Sunglow and Black
  • Part of the Sidekick Collection

products.title: The Good At Naps Hat
products.body_html:
Some people are good at spreadsheets. Some people are good at small talk. You are good at naps, and honestly, that takes talent. This two-tone cap says so right on the front, in a collegiate bar design that makes your finest skill look like a varsity sport.

Built on a 5-panel garment washed twill snapback from The Game, the same headwear house that has been making caps since 1948. The firm front panel holds the embroidery crisp, the ivory crown keeps it classic, and the navy bill ties it all together. Adjustable snapback closure means one size fits nearly every head, including the one currently resting on a pillow.

Wear it to the farmers market. Wear it on the couch. Wear it to bed if you want, we are not your supervisor.

The Details

  • 5-panel garment washed cotton twill construction 
  • Structured front panel with flat embroidery, navy and gumdrop threads
  • Adjustable snapback closure, one size fits most
  • "GOOD AT NAPS" flat embroidery on front (10.3cm x 4.0cm)
  • Swoveralls arched embroidery on back (8.9cm x 1.7cm)
  • Ivory crown, navy bill and button
  • Part of the Sidekick Collection

products.title: The Free Your Waistband Hat
products.body_html:
The dressed-up sibling of the beanie, for the other three seasons. Same message, different altitude. This one is built on The Game's Comfort Twill rope cap, an enzyme washed cotton twill that feels broken-in on day one, like it already spent a summer on your porch.

The 5-panel mid-pro crown gives it structure without stiffness, the slightly curved bill splits the difference between dad hat and flat brim, and the white rope across the front adds that retro clubhouse detail we could not resist. Flip it over and there is tonal art on the underbill, a small detail for the people who notice small details.

Waistbands are a choice. Choose freedom.

The Details

  • Enzyme washed cotton twill (Comfort Twill)
  • 5-panel mid-pro crown, structured
  • Slightly curved bill with tonal underbill art (4.6cm x 1.3cm)
  • White rope detail across front
  • Plastic snapback closure, one size fits most
  • Front flat embroidery (11.0cm x 7.5cm), white, navy, and light grey threads
  • Topstitching matches panel color
  • Part of the Sidekick Collection
